title: The isotopes: masses, natural abundance, half-lives, decay modes and decay energies (GEN.438)
sources: NIST, Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions with Relative Atomic Masses (physics.nist.gov/Comp): the relative atomic mass (u) of each isotope and its natural isotopic composition (IUPAC)

NUBASE2020 (Kondev et al., Chin. Phys. C 45, 030001, 2021, [R2443]), www-nds.iaea.org/amdc/ame2020/nubase_4.mas20.txt: ground-state half-lives (the year is the Julian year of 365.25 days), decay modes and their branchings in percent
Lugaro, Ott and Kereszturi, Prog. Part. Nucl. Phys. 102, 1 (2018), [R2768: Table 4]: decay_energy_j, the energy released per decay (the whole chain for a parent that has one), without the neutrinos
Dye, Rev. Geophys. 50, RG3007 (2012), [R1203: Table 2]: dye_2012, the heat constants of 238U, 235U, 232Th and 40K (kept as the cross-check: the newer evaluation wins where they differ)
notes: abundance is an atom fraction of the element in normal material, null for an isotope that is not primordial; modes are NUBASE2020's [mode, percent] pairs; masses are of the neutral atom.
